label: Money held in credit institutions and elsewhere, with his wife (end of 2023)
detail: As reported by LRT's investigations unit from the annual asset declaration data published by the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI). According to LRT he had not filed a declaration for 2024. Lithuanian state politicians file an annual family asset declaration (metinė gyventojo (šeimos) turto deklaracija) whose public extract VMI publishes; VMI's extract viewer builds its content with scripts and could not be read by the harvest for this research, so the figures are taken from LRT, which cites the declarations.
